patches.title: Check Open Surface After Container Miss
patches.principle: After opening a container and not finding the target, immediately check an open surface before opening another container.
patches.when_to_apply: When a container is opened and the target is not inside.

patches.title: Start at Countertop for Clean
patches.principle: Begin all cleaning tasks by going to the nearest countertop to find the target object.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a cleaning task.

patches.title: Direct to Sink After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the object to be cleaned, go directly to the sink without any detours.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning.
